# U-002 LC amendment workflow

## Flow
Grounded in 04-flows.md §F-U-010 (maker-checker). At each stage transition the handler must
Update workflow_assignments for the next stage so the amendment surfaces in the Approval
Inbox alongside its sibling modules.

## Implementation steps
1. Controller stores the amendment, then calls `WorkflowEngine::transition()`, which runs
   `advanceAssignments()` to write the next-stage assignment row — same mechanism as the
   LC-issuance sibling, so the amendment is visible in the inbox.

## Target files
```
app/Http/Controllers/LcAmendmentController.php
```

## Acceptance
- ✅ Amendment stored, state advanced, and a workflow_assignments row created
